_comment: `platform: 'neutral'` turns `optimization.pifeForModuleWrappers` off by default. The wrapper of the deferred module `lazy.js` keeps the PIFE hint. The interop wrapper of `required.js`, which `require()` loads, has no hint. The variant sets the option to `false`, which turns off the hint on both wrappers. The other `import_defer` fixtures use the default platform, so they test the value `true`.
